messages:
maria (AE): Zenith just sent a 30+ question RFI and an attached capability matrix. Asks: on-prem HSM integration, EU data residency, Dedicated sizing for bursty chat, hosted vs committed pricing bands, PO C success criteria, and an editable SOW. They want a packet by Wed EOD. @samuel @nora can you lead tech + security?

samuel (SE): On it. Quick clarifying Qs for the customer before we craft formal responses: 1) what sustained qps and expected p95 targets? 2) which model families (LlamaX / Mistral / open weights) need to be validated? 3) do they require streaming and tool-calls during the POC?

maria (AE): From the discovery call: two main flows interactive chat (avg 512 tokens, peak bursts ~60 qps) and batch embeddings (20k vectors nightly). They require EU data residency and HSM for key custody. Streaming chat required.

devon (SRE): For 60 qps on 512-token average, recommend Dedicated: 4 x A10G-equivalent GPUs (or 2 x A100p) for stable p95 latency. Batch embeddings can be offloaded to nightly worker pool to save cost. Note: warm KV cache and prewarming are important to avoid cold-start P99 spikes.

nora (Security): Security questionnaire notes: need vendor HSM details (PKCS#11 vs KMIP), audit log retention, private network connectivity (VPC peering / private link), and redacted SOC2 / pen test artifacts. We do not operate in FedRAMP, but can map controls for a private deployment; will recommend partner path for full FedRAMP requirements. I will draft the security section and attach certs.

ellie (Sales Eng): I will author the capability matrix responses and assemble attachments: 1) feature-by-feature matrix (HSM, on-prem deployment, streaming, model catalog, quantization), 2) POC runbook PDF, 3) editable SOW template, 4) estimated cost table.

samuel (SE): Proposed POC timeline: Week 0: infra prep & security signoff; Week 1: ingest & baseline hosted test; Week 2: Dedicated/private deploy + perf tuning; Week 3: acceptance & handoff. Acceptance criteria: sustained 50 qps @ <1500ms p95 for chat, embedding throughput >= 100k vectors/hr (example), and quality parity on 50 prompt eval.

maria (AE): Pricing: they want hosted per-token and committed dedicated monthly band with burst allowance. Also request a line-item POC estimate (3 weeks). Can finance provide committed tiers and overage mechanics?

ellie (Sales Eng): POC cost template: SE effort (2 SEs, 20h/week each), SRE (10h/week), Dedicated infra credits (~$6k GPU runtime), plus legal review. I will include an itemized table in the packet.

devon (SRE): Warning: if customer insists on on-prem HSM + air-gapped deployment, expect appliance lead time (2-4 weeks) and extra validation. Call this out in timeline to avoid surprises.

nora (Security): Uploading redacted SOC2 and PEN summary to the shared RFI folder now: <https://rwd.internal/zenith-rfi>. Also requesting customer confirm HSM vendor and whether they need PKCS#11 or KMIP.

samuel (SE): Tech attachment: sample mapping for Redwood Private KMS config: ```
redwood_private:
  kms_provider: "customer_hsm"
  hsm_interface: "pkcs11"
  key_alias: "zenith-poc-key"
  network: "vpc-peering"
```

maria (AE): Action items: @ellie draft the capability matrix + written answers; @nora draft security Q responses + attach certs; @samuel prepare SOW and perf targets; @devon note infra lead times and Dedicated config. I will confirm HSM vendor and token targets with the buyer.

ellie (Sales Eng): Will draft and loop in legal for SOW clauses. I aim to post a first-pass packet by tomorrow morning for review.

nora (Security): Added attachments to RFI folder. Please review redactions and confirm any additional evidence needed.

devon (SRE): Opened internal ticket for Dedicated capacity hold for tentative POC dates: INC-7892. @samuel please link perf harness.

samuel (SE): Perf harness: <https://rwd.tools/perf-harness>  will use 512-token profile and our logging knobs to capture p95/p99.

maria (AE): Goal: send consolidated RFI packet Wed EOD. Flag blockers here early. :thumbsup:

ellie (Sales Eng): Draft uploaded to internal repo: sources/internal/zenith/zenith-capability-packet-draft.pdf  requesting technical & security review before finalizing. :wave:
